messages:
Elaine Park: Heads-up — interview scheduled tomorrow 11:00am PST for ML Infra IC4. Two panelists just dropped (family emergency + travel). Can volunteers cover the tech deep-dive and debrief lead? Need someone to own final scoring. Thanks!

Samir Patel: I can take tech deep-dive 11:00–11:30. @Jordan Liu if you can do behavioral?

Jordan Liu: I can do behavioral, but quick rubric Q: where should we score 'system scalability' vs 'runtime operations'? The rubric has 'system design' and 'infrastructure' columns — which gets 'scalability' points?

Elaine Park: Put 'scalability' under 'system design'. 'Runtime operations' maps to 'infrastructure'. Sorry for the overlap. Updated rubric here: https://redwood.example/rubric/ml-infra (view-only). Also added a tiny note under each column: `one-sentence rationale required` — copy below:

```
system design: assess architecture choices, scaling tradeoffs, and latency-cost reasoning.
infrastructure: assess deployment, monitoring, and runtime ops experience.
```

Maya K: I'll be debrief lead and compile scores. @Samir can you ensure recording permissions are granted to people-ops and me?

Samir Patel: Yep, will update candidate recording and share link in #people-ops 10m before. Also can someone cover 11:30–12:00? I'm booked right at 11:30.

Ravi Singh: I can cover 11:30–12:00 but I have a 11:20 meeting ending — will join by 11:35 if that's okay.

Elaine Park: That's fine, we'll shuffle the schedule: Samir 11:00–11:30 tech, Ravi 11:35–12:00 follow-up; Jordan behavioral. Checklist: join 5m early, use rubric link, leave one-sentence rationale per score, paste any flag into the debrief doc. :thumbsup:

Interview Bot: Reminder set — candidate interview tomorrow 11:00 PST. Recording will start when first panelist joins.

Maya K: I'll create the debrief doc and paste rubric snippet. Assigning myself as debrief owner. Thanks all!
